title: OUTCH — screen output routines
description: OUTCH — screen output routines. 4 recovered saves.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: OUTCH SCREEN OUTPUT
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Complete EDTASM: D3/six-byte name; five high-bit decimal digits, printable source/tabs and CR per record; final 1A at exact EOF; exact left/right bytes
versions.unavailableReason: Incomplete, uncertain, or nonstandard captured payload; see the recovery validation. This format or machine is not supported by the shared stock Level II BASIC player. Source/development material; no self-contained stock Level II player is supplied.
versions.startupSource:
06650 OUTCH	EQU	$	;SUBROUTINE TO PRINT ON SCREEN
06750 			; INPUT  A,ZERO   B,CHARACTER
06850 CURS	DEFW	$	;LOCATION OF SCREEN
06950 SCREEN	EQU	15360	;BEGINING OF SCREEN MEM
07050 	PUSH	HL	;SAVE HL
07150 	LD	HL,(CURS) ; PUT LOCATION IN HL
07250 	PUS@	DE	;SAVE DE
07350 	LD	DE,1024
07450 	SBC	HL,DE
07550 	JP	M,GOOD
07650 SCROLL	EQU	$ ;SCROLL UP
07750 	PUSH	HL
